name: founders-os
description: CRM, tasks, finances, feeds, and durable memory for founders, running on Postgres you own.
long_description:
The signals that matter to a founder are rarely in one place. A quiet task, a client nobody has spoken to in nine days, an open invoice. Separately unremarkable. Together, a decision you did not know you needed to make.

Founders OS gives an AI assistant a durable working memory of your business, so it can see those things at once and tell you about them.

## What your assistant can do

**Customers and relationships.** Track customers, contacts, and every interaction. Pull a single card showing everything about an account: open tasks, recent conversations, invoices, history.

**Tasks and playbooks.** Create, assign, link, and complete work. Surface what is overdue, blocked, or quietly stalled. Turn a repeatable process into a playbook and run it.

**Finances.** Accounts, transactions, transfers, categories, and P&L reporting, with per-member access control over who can see what.

**Memory that persists.** Store org-wide and personal knowledge with semantic recall, so context survives across sessions, tools, and teammates instead of dying with a chat window.

**Daily orientation.** Start a session with a briefing that pulls together what fired while you were away, what is stuck, what is coming, and recent activity.

**Feeds and projects.** Subscribe to sources, get briefings, and organize work into projects with real history.

## Your data stays yours

Founders OS runs locally over stdio against a Supabase project you create and control. Nothing is stored on our servers, and there is no account to create with us. If you stop using it, your data is already where it lives: a Postgres database you own, that you can query, export, or take somewhere else. That is a deliberate design choice, not a limitation.

## Setup

You need a Supabase project and an embedding provider key before first use.

1. Go to https://foundersmcp.com/setup and enter your Supabase credentials and embedding settings. Your credentials never leave the browser.
2. Run the generated SQL in your Supabase SQL Editor.
3. Install this extension and paste the values into the fields it prompts for.

If you install before running the schema, Founders OS will notice and tell you exactly what to do next, rather than failing with a confusing database error.

## Try it

- "Catch me up"
- "Add Acme Corp as a new prospect"
- "Log a call with Sarah at Acme, we discussed pricing"
- "Create a task to send the proposal by Friday and link it to Acme"
- "What's stuck or overdue?"
- "Show me everything about Acme Corp"
- "Remember for the org: we're targeting SMB fintech this quarter"
- "What can you do?"

## Requirements

- Node.js 18 or later (bundled with Claude Desktop)
- A Supabase project
- An embedding provider: OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Ollama

MIT licensed. Source at https://github.com/OurThinkTank/founders-os

supabase_secret_key.title: Supabase secret key
supabase_secret_key.description: Service-role secret key (starts with sb_secret_). Stored securely by your client and never sent to OurThinkTank.

company_id.title: Company ID
company_id.description: A unique slug for your org, for example acme-co. Everyone on the same Supabase project using this value shares that company's data. Leave blank to run against the sample company.

user_id.title: Your user ID
user_id.description: Identifies you for personal memory scope, for example doug. Each team member should use a distinct value. Letters, numbers, underscore, and hyphen only.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone, for example America/Los_Angeles. Leave blank to use your computer's timezone.

embedding_provider.title: Embedding provider
embedding_provider.description: One of: openai, bedrock, ollama. Required for the memory tools.

embedding_model.title: Embedding model
embedding_model.description: Leave blank for the provider default: openai text-embedding-3-small, bedrock amazon.nova-2-multimodal-embeddings-v1:0, ollama nomic-embed-text.

embedding_dim.title: Embedding dimensions
embedding_dim.description: MUST match the vector() size used when you ran setup.sql. openai/3-small = 1536, bedrock/nova = 1024, ollama/nomic = 768. Never change this after setup.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Required only when the embedding provider is openai.

aws_region.title: AWS region
aws_region.description: Required only when the embedding provider is bedrock. Credentials come from the standard AWS credential chain.

ollama_base_url.title: Ollama base URL
ollama_base_url.description: Required only when the embedding provider is ollama.
